signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION DLANGB( NORM, N, KL, KU, AB, LDAB,

params.name: norm
params.reference: Specifies the value to be returned in DLANGB as described above.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$. When $N = 0$, DLANGB is set to zero.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The number of sub-diagonals of the matrix A. $\mathrm{KL} \ge 0$.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The number of super-diagonals of the matrix A. $\mathrm{KU} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: The band matrix A, stored in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: `AB(ku+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{ku}) \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kl})$.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: where $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge N$ when `NORM = 'I'`; otherwise, `WORK` is not referenced.

notes: no derivable minimum length for workspace WORK
